label: Finite models for the maxime ens and potency sense forks
paraphrase: Finite interpretations for the maxime-ens and potency forks: per term, a model in which coverage holds, exclusivity fails, the two uses are read in different senses, every other premise of the joint theorem holds and its conclusion fails; per term, the same with coverage failing instead; a nonvacuity witness per joint theorem; for MAXIME_2 and MAXIME_3, a model of the existence-layer branch without its sense bridge in which the conclusion fails; a tied-maxima model in which the STRICT causal principle holds vacuously and STMT-MAXIMUM-IN-BEING-CAUSES-ALL-BEINGS fails; a model with asymmetric more-in and two tied maximal beings, so that a MAXIMAL being exists and no STRICTLY greatest one does; and omission models for both premises of the ADOPTED potency branch. Satisfiability and omission only; no model describes reality.
